'''Scrib Leras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] accountant for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateNobleMale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Scrib Leras]]
[[File:ZodaBurb.png|thumb|left|170px|Scrib Leras character model, actually used for Zoda Burb]]
The game's creature database indicates that a specific Human male model was used to depict Scrib Leras. However, the randomized "noble_male" template was actually used for the Jabba's Theme Park. The Scrib Leras character model was nevertheless used for another character called [[Zoda Burb]].
